subject: MSA & Order Form: Crestline onboarding questions and redline timeline
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@crestline.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@crestline.com
Date: 2026-11-20T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: MSA & Order Form kickoff for Crestline

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking this — excited to get Redwood standing up for our internal clinician assistant project. Attached are the initial drafts we have from procurement and legal: Crestline_MSA_v1.docx and OrderForm_Crestline.xlsx. A few things to call out from our side so you can route internally: 

- Target go-live: 2027-01-10 (pilot, 25 seats).
- Billing: Crestline Health (EIN 12-3456789), billing contact: Maria Delgado <maria.delgado@crestline.com>.
- Data residency: primary region us-east-1 but clinical records must remain in US-only.
- Security evidentiary ask: we will need SOC2 report and a summary of access controls.
- Retention: our legal team expects certain logs (audit trails) to be retained for 7 years for compliance.

Can you confirm who on the Redwood side will own commercial vs. security items and what the expected turnaround is for a first-pass redline? We generally like a 3–5 business day turnaround for initial redlines but can be flexible.

If helpful, happy to jump on a 30-minute call this week — Elena and our procurement lead are available Thu/Fri afternoons.

Best,
Elena Park
Head of Procurement, Crestline Health
elena@crestline.com

Attachments: Crestline_MSA_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document), OrderForm_Crestline.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
To: Elena Park <elena@crestline.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-21T09:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form kickoff for Crestline

Hi Elena — thanks for sending and for the clear bullets. Looping in the owners on our side so we can move quickly: 

- Kimberly Park (commercial lead) will own commercial terms and order form pricing/seat counts.
- Marissa Cole (contracts) will own the redline response and produce a redline matrix.
- Jonas Weber (security) will own SOC2/evidence and comment on retention/residency feasibility.

Initial asks from our side to speed review:
1) Can you confirm the canonical payer name and billing email? (Maria's email included above — will use that unless you prefer a different contact.)
2) Please confirm whether the 7-year log retention applies to all telemetry/audit logs or only clinical audit trails — those have different operational costs.
3) Any third-party connectors we need to be aware of (e.g., EHR integrations, analytics providers)?

Proposed plan/timeline:
- 11/21: internal owners assigned (done).
- 11/22–11/24: Marissa will produce initial redline matrix and a short FAQ where we flag higher-risk clauses.
- Target 11/25: first-pass redline back to Crestline.

Marissa — I attached our standard intake checklist (internal use) and placeholder matrix so you can drop comments.

Elena — if Thu/Fri call works for you, Kimberly and I can join; otherwise we can keep this asynchronous.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com

Attachments: rw-intake-checklist.pdf (internal intake template)

From: Elena Park <elena@crestline.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@crestline.com
Date: 2026-11-22T14:26:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form kickoff for Crestline

Thanks Sofia — quick clarifications: 

- Canonical payer: Crestline Health, Attn: Maria Delgado, billing@crestline.com (please use billing@crestline.com for invoicing).
- Retention scope: 7 years applies to clinical audit trails and any logs that could be used in a compliance review. Telemetry (performance metrics) can be on a shorter retention window but should be available for 90 days.
- Third parties: we integrate with Epic (FHIR), and we use a managed analytics vendor (HealthSight) that will access non-PHI telemetry only.

I attached a short summary of the Crestline legal/regulatory constraints (crestline-legal-reqs.pdf). We are happy to run an NDA if that helps accelerate evidence sharing.

Elena

Attachments: crestline-legal-reqs.pdf (application/pdf)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-23T11:37:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: Crestline redline matrix (initial)

Sofia / team — I reviewed the Crestline_MSA_v1 and OrderForm. Key items I plan to include in the matrix (attached) and why: 

- Data residency clause: propose explicit language that production PHI stays in US-only regions and that any failover outside US requires prior written approval.
- Retention / logs: propose carveout that operational telemetry is retained 90 days; clinical audit trails retained up to 7 years with scoped access controls and cost recovery for extended storage.
- Telemetry clause: Crestline's ask for 7-year retention on "logs" is broad; need legal to weigh whether that applies to system-level telemetry. Recommend JonAS to advise on feasibility and cost impact.
- Limitation of liability: propose capping at aggregated fees for the first 12 months or a $X threshold — Kimberly to confirm acceptable commercial position.
- SLAs: suggest standard 99.9% availability for pilot, escalation path in Exhibit C.

I've added comments inline and exported an initial CSV matrix: crestline-redline-matrix.csv. Planning a 3-business-day turnaround for a substantive redline and an internal call on 11/24 to finalize.

Quoted for context: 
> Elena Park wrote:
> > Target go-live: 2027-01-10 (pilot, 25 seats).
> > Data residency: primary region us-east-1 but clinical records must remain in US-only.

Will circulate the produced redline and a short rationale doc.

—Marissa Cole
Senior Contracts Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: crestline-redline-matrix.csv (text/csv)

- Jonas: SOC2/evidence checklist and note on retention feasibility — delivering 11/25 EOD.

- Sofia: coordinate DocuSign path and HubSpot record (I'll update CRM with payer/billing details).

Proposed call: 11/25 11:00am EST (30 min) to walk through redline highlights and agree a short path to signature for pilot. If that works, please confirm and I'll send a calendar invite.

Links: HubSpot record (https://hubspot.company/record/CRM-48291), Intake folder (https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-crestline-intake), draft DocuSign envelope (https://www.docusign.com/en/link/crestline-msa).
